Below is `MHCDScript v2`, a general-purpose programming language design for the full 64-axiom MHCD system.

The main upgrade from v1 is that v2 treats the MHCD as a state machine with typed records, verified transitions, constructive execution, context-indexed competence, and innocence-preserving correction.

# MHCDScript v2

```mhcd
language MHCDScript version 2

subject "Dominic Alexander Cooper"

runtime MHCD {
    principle existence
    principle pain_signal
    principle learning_update
    principle constructive_proof
    principle innocence_preservation
    principle competence_space
    principle context_indexing
    principle tool_extension
}
```

## 1. Design purpose

`MHCDScript v2` is a general-purpose scripting language for directing the human mind, body, environment, and tools as one distributed cognitive database.

Its purpose is to:

```mhcd
purpose {
    reduce pain by increasing competence
    detect incompetence without guilt
    reject contradiction as a learning engine
    prefer error_free_construction
    quantify competence and incompetence
    optimize competence_basis across contexts
    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

The governing command is:

```mhcd
enforce {
    014: "Everyone is innocent"
    015: "Competence is a functional axial n-dimensional space"
}
```

So every program must preserve:

```mhcd
error != guilt
mistake == update_requirement
learning == competence_increase
construction == preferred_proof_engine
```

## 2. Full axiom import

Rather than rewriting all 64 axioms inside every script, v2 imports them as a standard library.

```mhcd
import MHCD.AXIOMS.000_063
import MHCD.BOOLEAN
import MHCD.LAMBDA
import MHCD.COMPETENCE_SPACE
import MHCD.CONSTRUCTIVE_VALIDATION
```

The full axiom set is treated as:

```mhcd
axiom_set FULL_MHCD = {
    000..063
}
```

Every axiom is internally available as a Boolean truth constant:

```mhcd
AXIOM[000] = true
AXIOM[014] = true
AXIOM[015] = true
AXIOM[063] = true
```

A program is valid only if it does not violate the enforced axioms:

```mhcd
program_valid := respects(014) * respects(015) * rejects(guilt) * prefers(construction)
```

## 3. Primitive types

```mhcd
type Bool              = 0 | 1
type Number            = integer | decimal
type Text              = string
type List<T>           = ordered collection
type Set<T>            = unordered collection
type Map<K,V>          = key-value collection

type AxiomID           = 000..063
type Subject           = living information-bearing system
type Mind              = internal meaning processor
type Body              = procedural competence store
type Environment       = auxiliary cue/storage field
type Tool              = external operator
type Note              = persistent external memory
type Diagram           = spatial index
type Calendar          = temporal index
type Checklist         = procedural compression
type Query             = question operation
type Answer            = retrieved or constructed record
type Context           = coordinate region in competence-space
type Skill             = axis in competence-space
type Habit             = repeated function over time
type PainSignal        = system signal
type Mistake           = detected incompetence marker
type Correction        = competence-restoring update
type Contradiction     = corruption signal
type Construction      = error-free build sequence
type Competence        = quantified functional capacity
type Incompetence      = quantified missing constructive capacity
type BasisSpan         = transferable competence basis across contexts
```

## 4. Boolean arithmetic

```mhcd
A + B       // OR, union, either condition accepted
A * B       // AND, both conditions enforced
!A          // NOT
A -> B      // implication
A == B      // equivalence
A != B      // non-equivalence
```

Example:

```mhcd
rule R001:
    AXIOM[004] * AXIOM[005] -> operation.learn.valid
```

Meaning:

If `I can learn` and `Learning increases competence`, then `learn` is a valid update operation.

## 5. Lambda calculus layer

MHCDScript v2 supports lambda-style reusable operations.

```mhcd
lambda learn(x):
    ingest x
    encode x
    index x
    construct x
    validate x
    update competence
    return competence_delta(x)
```

```mhcd
lambda correct_without_guilt(error):
    enforce AXIOM[014]
    mark error as update_requirement
    locate missing_basis(error)
    construct correction(error)
    validate correction(error)
    return competence_restored
```

```mhcd
lambda optimize_context(skill, context):
    measure competence(skill, context)
    measure incompetence(skill, context)
    construct basis_improvement(skill, context)
    validate basis_improvement
    update competence_space
    return optimized(skill, context)
```

## 6. Program structure

Every valid v2 program has this form:

```mhcd
program "Program Name" {
    use FULL_MHCD

    define subject
    define contexts
    define skills
    define tools
    define records

    execute operations

    verify constructive_integrity
    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

Minimal valid program:

```mhcd
program "Minimum MHCD Runtime" {
    use FULL_MHCD

    subject self = "Dominic Alexander Cooper"

    ingest current_state
    detect pain
    measure competence
    measure incompetence
    construct correction
    validate correction
    update competence_space

    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

## 7. State model

The MHCD runtime is a state machine.

```mhcd
state MHCD_STATE {
    subject: Subject
    mind: Mind
    body: Body
    environment: Environment
    tools: Set<Tool>

    records: Set<Record>
    contexts: Set<Context>
    skills: Set<Skill>
    habits: Set<Habit>
    schedules: Set<Calendar>

    competence: Map<Skill, Number>
    incompetence: Map<Skill, Number>

    pain_signals: List<PainSignal>
    mistakes: List<Mistake>
    contradictions: List<Contradiction>
    corrections: List<Correction>

    enforced_axioms: Set<AxiomID>
}
```

A state transition has the form:

```mhcd
transition NAME(input_state) -> output_state {
    precondition condition
    operation operations
    postcondition condition
}
```

Example:

```mhcd
transition LEARN(input_state) -> output_state {
    precondition AXIOM[004] * AXIOM[005]

    operation {
        ingest input
        encode input
        index input
        construct usable_record
        validate usable_record
        update competence
    }

    postcondition competence(output_state) >= competence(input_state)
}
```

## 8. Core operations

### `ingest`

```mhcd
ingest source
ingest source as type
ingest source into context
```

Examples:

```mhcd
ingest "textbook chapter" as Note into "mathematics"
ingest "pain after failed proof" as PainSignal into "proof writing"
ingest "work feedback" as Record into "professional competence"
```

### `encode`

```mhcd
encode input as structure
```

Examples:

```mhcd
encode "ring" as definition + example + non_example
encode "daily exercise" as habit
encode "project architecture" as diagram
```

### `index`

```mhcd
index record with tags
index record under context
index skill on axis
```

Examples:

```mhcd
index "ideal" with ["ring theory", "substructure", "quotient"]
index "proof writing" under context "mathematics"
index "attention control" on axis "cognitive regulation"
```

### `query`

```mhcd
query question
query question from records
query question under context
```

Example:

```mhcd
query "What is the weakest skill axis today?" under context "mathematics"
```

### `construct`

```mhcd
construct object
construct object from components
construct object by steps
```

Example:

```mhcd
construct proof "kernel of ring homomorphism is ideal" by steps
```

### `validate`

```mhcd
validate object
validate object against axioms
validate object by construction
```

Example:

```mhcd
validate proof against {008, 014, 015}
```

### `detect`

```mhcd
detect pain
detect mistake
detect contradiction
detect incompetence
detect missing_basis
detect context_shift
```

Example:

```mhcd
detect incompetence in "proof construction"
```

### `correct`

```mhcd
correct mistake
correct mistake with construction
correct incompetence by practice
```

Example:

```mhcd
correct "failed proof step" with direct construction
```

### `measure`

```mhcd
measure competence
measure incompetence
measure competence in skill
measure competence in skill under context
```

Example:

```mhcd
measure competence in "applied ring theory" under context "quiet study"
```

### `optimize`

```mhcd
optimize competence_basis
optimize skill across contexts
optimize basis_span for all_contexts
```

Example:

```mhcd
optimize "proof writing" across ["quiet study", "exam", "teaching", "coding"]
```

### `externalize`

```mhcd
externalize record to tool
externalize memory to note
externalize intention to calendar
externalize procedure to checklist
```

Example:

```mhcd
externalize "weekly learning plan" to calendar
```

### `schedule`

```mhcd
schedule action at time
schedule review every interval
schedule habit under context
```

Example:

```mhcd
schedule review "ring theory definitions" every 2 days
```

### `execute`

```mhcd
execute plan
execute checklist
execute habit
execute construction
```

Example:

```mhcd
execute "daily competence plan"
```

### `feedback`

```mhcd
feedback result
feedback result into record
feedback result updates competence_space
```

Example:

```mhcd
feedback "proof completed with two mistakes"
```

### `enforce`

```mhcd
enforce axiom
enforce axiom_set
enforce {014 + 015}
```

Example:

```mhcd
enforce {
    AXIOM[014]
    AXIOM[015]
}
```

## 9. Records

A `record` is the universal database unit.

```mhcd
record ID {
    type: Note | Skill | Tool | Query | Answer | Habit | Correction | PainSignal | Context
    content: Text
    tags: List<Text>
    context: Context
    source: Text
    validated: Bool
    competence_effect: Number
    incompetence_effect: Number
}
```

Example:

```mhcd
record "MATH-RING-001" {
    type: Note
    content: "A ring is an algebraic structure with addition and multiplication."
    tags: ["algebra", "ring theory", "definition"]
    context: "mathematics"
    source: "constructed study note"
    validated: 1
    competence_effect: +0.05
    incompetence_effect: -0.02
}
```

## 10. Competence-space

Competence-space is an n-dimensional functional axial space.

```mhcd
competence_space "SELF" {
    axis memory
    axis attention
    axis reasoning
    axis proof_construction
    axis language
    axis tool_use
    axis bodily_energy
    axis emotional_regulation
    axis environment_design
    axis context_switching
}
```

Skills are embedded in competence-space:

```mhcd
skill "applied ring theory" {
    axes: [memory, reasoning, proof_construction, language]
    context: "mathematics"
    current_competence: 0.35
    target_competence: 0.90
}
```

Competence can be context-indexed:

```mhcd
context "quiet room" {
    modifies "applied ring theory" by +0.15
}

context "sleep deprivation" {
    modifies "applied ring theory" by -0.30
}
```

## 11. Error and contradiction handling

A mistake is never treated as guilt.

```mhcd
handler on_mistake(m):
    enforce AXIOM[014]
    mark m as detected_incompetence
    query "What basis is missing?"
    construct correction
    validate correction
    update competence_space
```

Contradiction is treated as a corruption signal.

```mhcd
handler on_contradiction(c):
    enforce AXIOM[006]
    mark c as corruption_signal
    quarantine c
    construct direct_alternative
    validate direct_alternative
```

Pain is treated as a system signal.

```mhcd
handler on_pain(p):
    enforce AXIOM[018]
    classify p

    if p.cause == incompetence:
        correct p.cause

    if p.cause == overload:
        reduce load

    if p.cause == contradiction:
        quarantine contradiction

    if p.cause == environment:
        modify context
```

## 12. Verification system

A script must pass four checks.

```mhcd
verify script {
    check axiom_consistency
    check constructive_preference
    check innocence_preservation
    check competence_update_path
}
```

### Axiom consistency

```mhcd
check axiom_consistency:
    no operation may deny AXIOM[014]
    no operation may deny AXIOM[015]
    no operation may treat contradiction as preferred learning
```

### Constructive preference

```mhcd
check constructive_preference:
    if proof_method == contradiction:
        reject as learning_engine
    if proof_method == construction:
        accept as learning_engine
```

### Innocence preservation

```mhcd
check innocence_preservation:
    if mistake detected:
        require correction_without_guilt
```

### Competence update path

```mhcd
check competence_update_path:
    if incompetence detected:
        require measurable correction
```

## 13. General-purpose control flow

```mhcd
if condition:
    operation
else:
    operation
```

```mhcd
while condition:
    operation
```

```mhcd
for item in collection:
    operation item
```

```mhcd
try_construct object:
    construct object
    validate object
on_error error:
    correct error
```

Example:

```mhcd
for skill in all_skills:
    measure competence in skill
    if incompetence(skill) > 0.30:
        correct skill by deliberate_practice
```

## 15. Example program: daily runtime

```mhcd
program "MHCD Daily Runtime v2" {
    use FULL_MHCD
    use module "Learning"
    use module "Health"

    subject self = "Dominic Alexander Cooper"

    context current = detect context
    pain current_pain = detect pain
    energy current_energy = detect energy

    measure competence in all_skills under current
    measure incompetence in all_skills under current

    query "What competence update gives the greatest pain reduction today?"

    construct plan "daily competence plan" {
        item health_action
        item learning_action
        item work_action
        item tool_action
        item reflection_action
    }

    validate plan by construction
    externalize plan to checklist
    schedule review "daily competence plan" at "evening"

    execute checklist

    feedback result into competence_space

    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

## 16. Example program: learning applied ring theory

```mhcd
program "Learn Applied Ring Theory v2" {
    use FULL_MHCD
    use module "Mathematics"

    skill "applied ring theory" {
        axes: [memory, reasoning, proof_construction, language, tool_use]
        context: "mathematics"
        current_competence: measure
        target_competence: 0.90
    }

    ingest "definition of ring"
    encode "ring" as definition + example + non_example
    index "ring" with ["algebra", "ring theory", "binary operations"]

    ingest "definition of ideal"
    encode "ideal" as definition + example + non_example
    index "ideal" with ["ring theory", "substructure", "quotient"]

    construct proof "kernel of ring homomorphism is ideal" by direct_steps
    validate proof by error_free_construction

    if detect contradiction:
        quarantine contradiction
        construct direct_alternative

    measure competence in "applied ring theory"
    correct detected_incompetence by deliberate_practice

    externalize summary to note
    schedule review "ring theory definitions" every "2 days"

    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

## 17. Example program: contradiction quarantine

```mhcd
program "Contradiction Quarantine v2" {
    use FULL_MHCD

    input claim

    detect contradiction in claim

    if contradiction == true:
        mark claim as corruption_signal
        quarantine claim

        query "What direct constructive alternative exists?"

        construct alternative_proof
        validate alternative_proof by error_free_construction

        update records with alternative_proof
        update competence_space

    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

## 18. Example program: competence optimiser

```mhcd
program "Competence Basis Optimizer v2" {
    use FULL_MHCD

    define contexts = [
        "quiet study",
        "public explanation",
        "exam condition",
        "work condition",
        "fatigue condition",
        "tool-supported condition"
    ]

    define skills = [
        "mathematics",
        "programming",
        "physical training",
        "attention control",
        "communication",
        "environment design"
    ]

    for skill in skills:
        for context in contexts:
            measure competence in skill under context
            measure incompetence in skill under context

            if incompetence(skill, context) > 0:
                construct basis_improvement for skill under context
                validate basis_improvement
                practice skill under context
                update competence_space

    optimize basis_span across contexts

    enforce {014 + 015}
}
```

## 19. Interpreter architecture

A real interpreter for MHCDScript v2 would need these components:

```mhcd
interpreter MHCDScriptV2 {
    lexer
    parser
    ast_builder
    axiom_registry
    type_checker
    state_engine
    verifier
    command_executor
    record_store
    competence_model
    context_model
    tool_bridge
    scheduler_bridge
    report_generator
}
```

Execution pipeline:

```mhcd
source_file
    -> lexer
    -> parser
    -> abstract_syntax_tree
    -> axiom_verifier
    -> type_checker
    -> state_transition_engine
    -> constructive_validator
    -> execution_log
    -> updated_MHCD_state
```

## 22. Core semantic law

The central semantic law of MHCDScript v2 is:

```mhcd
semantic_law MHCD_CORE:
    existence
    * pain_signal
    * learning_capacity
    * measurable_competence
    * context_indexing
    * innocence
    * competence_space
    -> constructive_self_update_runtime
```

In compact Boolean form:

```mhcd
000 * 001 * 004 * 005 * 010 * 011 * 012 * 013 * 014 * 015
    -> MHCD_RUNTIME
```

In lambda form:

```mhcd
λself.
    Exist(self)
    * Pain(self)
    * Learn(self)
    * Quantify(Competence(self))
    * Quantify(Incompetence(self))
    * ContextIndex(Competence(self))
    * Innocent(all)
    * FunctionalAxisSpace(Competence(self))
    -> MHCD_RUNTIME(self)
```

## 23. Final identity of MHCDScript v2

```mhcd
MHCDScript v2 =
    axiom-governed
    + typed
    + stateful
    + constructive
    + innocence-preserving
    + context-indexed
    + competence-measuring
    + incompetence-correcting
    + pain-signal-aware
    + contradiction-quarantining
    + tool-extensible
    + environment-integrated
    + schedulable
    + human-centric
```

The shortest expression of the language is:

```mhcd
detect pain;
locate incompetence;
correct without guilt;
learn by construction;
measure competence;
optimize across contexts;
enforce {014 + 015};
```

Version 2 is therefore not only a notation system. It is a programmable self-correction language for the mental human-centric database.
